product: A collaborative release-planning workspace for B2B software teams.

sequence.trigger: A contact starts a 14-day team trial.
sequence.goal: Activate a trial workspace before its day-14 end.
sequence.cadence_preference: front-load useful setup help in the first week, then taper
sequence.conversion_window: attribute activation to an email when completed within 3 days of delivery

role_segments.engineering_manager: Needs visibility into owners, blockers, and release readiness.
role_segments.product_ops: Needs repeatable handoffs and a shared launch process.
role_segments.founder: Needs a lightweight way to keep a small team aligned without adding ceremony.

approved_product_facts: HarborLoop connects a Git repository to a shared release workspace.
A release checklist can hold owners, due dates, and approval status.
Teammates can collaborate in the same workspace.
A workflow review is a live setup conversation, not a product purchase.

avoid: guarantees, fake scarcity, and unapproved discounts
claims that setup is instant, automatic, or requires zero work

exit: all three activation steps are complete
transfer_out: a workflow review is booked; move the contact to sales-assisted onboarding
suppress: a high-severity support case opened within the last 48 hours
eligibility_and_control.re_entry: Allow a new run only for a genuinely new trial at least 120 days after the prior trial ended, provided all current eligibility checks pass.
branching_priority: Exit or transfer checks take precedence over any message branch.
Otherwise target the earliest incomplete activation step.
A pricing view may route an unactivated contact to a workflow-review message, but must not be called activation.
